storyboard.claim: Sethe calls her scarred back a tree; Paul D does not accept it.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Paul D in the bed-room looks at Sethe's back with a worried, unconvinced face.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Opens the chapter's scar argument in the bedroom.
storyboard.addedInformation: Strikes the euphemism 'tree' as the narrator's rejected phrase.
storyboard.staging: Paul D leads the frame, thinking hard about the scar; the strike callout carries the rejection.

storyboard.claim: To Paul D the mark is a revolting clump of scars, not a tree.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Paul D alone, thinking, in the forest set, his memory turned away from the scar.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Paul D's reaction to the tree claim.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the physical reality the euphemism hides.
storyboard.staging: Sad, thinking Paul D: the callout does the disgust, the face does the memory.

storyboard.claim: Paul D remembers the real trees of Sweet Home, where the men sat together.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A real tree icon in the forest set, with Paul D thinking of the sycamores.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Contrast: the real tree against the scar.
storyboard.addedInformation: Places the real tree in Sweet Home, the remembered plantation.
storyboard.staging: Tree icon is literal here: a real tree he remembers, not the scar.

storyboard.claim: Calling the flesh a tree is a false name; the narrator rejects it.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Paul D pointing at the injured back, accusing the euphemism.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Second rejection of the tree name.
storyboard.addedInformation: Strikes the euphemism and names the flesh plainly.
storyboard.staging: Accusing point, worried face; no injury is drawn.

storyboard.claim: The scar is a ledger entry written on the skin.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A ledger notes icon: the accounting record that the scar is.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Turns the scar into the book's ledger metaphor.
storyboard.addedInformation: Ties the scar to the schoolteacher's ledger of traits.
storyboard.staging: Paul D thinking over the ledger icon: the accounting, not the tree.

storyboard.claim: Calling it a tree protects Sethe from the horror.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Sethe and Paul D in the kitchen, Sethe thinking with a worried face.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains why she keeps the tree name.
storyboard.addedInformation: Frames the tree name as self-protection, not truth.
storyboard.staging: Sethe leads the frame, worried; Paul D stands beside her as the one forcing the math.

storyboard.claim: Two ledgers: Sethe's written openly on her back, Paul D's locked inside his chest.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A two-bucket sorter diagram contrasting the two ledgers.
storyboard.onScreenText: Two ledgers: one on her back, one in his chest
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Structural comparison of Sethe and Paul D.
storyboard.addedInformation: Makes the two ledgers a visible pair.
storyboard.staging: The diagram carries the claim; Paul D is a quiet anchor.

storyboard.claim: Paul D survived by emptying his emotional account.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Paul D with a blank face, emptied, in the room set.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Leads into the tobacco tin math.
storyboard.addedInformation: The blank face names the emptiness the callout describes.
storyboard.staging: Blank face: apathy and numbness, the emptied account.

callout.text: An iron bit in his mouth

storyboard.claim: Paul D was collared and bitted at Sweet Home, unable to speak.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A chains icon with a frightened Paul D; the bit is named in the callout.
storyboard.onScreenText: An iron bit in his mouth
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Starts the Sweet Home memory of the bit.
storyboard.addedInformation: Chains reads literally as bound and controlled.
storyboard.staging: Afraid face, still body; no violence is staged.

storyboard.claim: Paul D locks eyes with the rooster named Mister.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Frightened Paul D, held in place, looking out at the yard.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Continues the bit memory into the rooster.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the rooster as Mister, the story's central comparison.
storyboard.staging: Afraid, unmoving Paul D; the rooster is named by the callout.

storyboard.claim: The rooster is completely free while Paul D is bitted.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Paul D with a blank face beside the callout that contrasts freedom.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The rooster is the contrast to Paul D's bit.
storyboard.addedInformation: Makes the rooster's freedom the claim, in plain words.
storyboard.staging: Blank Paul D: the contrast is in the callout, not a rooster face.

storyboard.claim: Paul D is reduced to an object while the rooster struts.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Blank Paul D in the yard, reduced, with the object callout.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Continues the rooster contrast.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the dehumanization directly.
storyboard.staging: Blank face reads as the reduction; no rooster is staged.

storyboard.claim: The moment of being bitted is psychologically devastating.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Sad, slumped Paul D in the room set.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Reflects on the bit and the rooster.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the devastation without staging harm.
storyboard.staging: Sad slump is grief and defeat, no injury drawn.

callout.text: The true cost of being owned

storyboard.claim: The cost of ownership is the math proving a rooster has more autonomy.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Paul D thinking, worried, the math of ownership in his face.
storyboard.onScreenText: The true cost of being owned
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains why the rooster moment matters.
storyboard.addedInformation: Frames the cost as the arithmetic of autonomy.
storyboard.staging: Worried, thinking face carries the reckoning.

storyboard.claim: The rooster gets to smile at Paul D while he licks iron.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Angry, still Paul D under the callout about the smiling rooster.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Restates the rooster contrast with anger.
storyboard.addedInformation: The callout names the smile; the face names the anger.
storyboard.staging: Angry face: the outrage at the rooster's freedom.

storyboard.claim: The math breaks the mind; the data point cannot be integrated.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Sad, slumped Paul D.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the rooster math.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the mental break directly.
storyboard.staging: Slump and sadness carry the breaking.

storyboard.claim: The question: how does one survive that arithmetic.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Worried, thinking Paul D asking the question.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Question that leads to the tin answer.
storyboard.addedInformation: Turns the narration into a direct question.
storyboard.staging: Thinking face for the unanswered question.

storyboard.claim: Paul D locks his feelings in a tobacco tin and shuts the ledger.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Blank Paul D holding a key, the locking gesture.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Answers the survival question.
storyboard.addedInformation: The key shows the locking; the callout names the shutdown.
storyboard.staging: Key in hand, blank face: locking the feelings away.

storyboard.claim: Paul D's heart is rusted shut inside his chest.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Sad Paul D, idle, with the rusted-shut callout.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Describes where the tin is buried.
storyboard.addedInformation: Says rusted, not romantic: no heart icon.
storyboard.staging: Sad idle face; the heart icon is left out to avoid a love reading.

storyboard.claim: The math of slavery will literally drive a person insane.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Worried, thinking Paul D under the insanity callout.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Gives the reason for the shutdown.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the psychological cost directly.
storyboard.staging: Worried thinking face for the threat of madness.

storyboard.claim: Paul D is sold and sent to the trenches of Alfred, Georgia.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Sad Paul D walking along the street set, leaving.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Gives the place of the sale.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the place from the narration.
storyboard.staging: Walk: being sent away, sad face.

storyboard.claim: Paul D is chained to 45 other men in the mud.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A chains icon with worried Paul D, the count in the callout.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Describes the chain gang conditions.
storyboard.addedInformation: Chains reads literally as bound.
storyboard.staging: Worried, still face; no fighting or falling is staged.

storyboard.claim: He operates only on the primitive part of his brain, shutting it down.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Blank Paul D, idle, the shutdown named.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Continues the chain gang survival.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the shutdown as the survival mechanism.
storyboard.staging: Blank face reads as numbness, the shutdown.

storyboard.claim: Paul D remembers the schoolteacher calculating his exact price.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Worried Paul D thinking, the schoolteacher in the room behind him.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The economic math keeps running.
storyboard.addedInformation: Connects the price to the schoolteacher's ledger.
storyboard.staging: Paul D leads, thinking; the schoolteacher is the memory.

storyboard.claim: Paul D obsessively calculates the worth of his friends.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Worried, thinking Paul D under the worth callout.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Shows the math turned onto the friends.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the obsession as a calculation.
storyboard.staging: Thinking face for the obsessive reckoning.

storyboard.claim: Paul D wonders what Mrs. Garner got for selling his brother.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Sad, thinking Paul D.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: A specific case of the math.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the seller from the narration.
storyboard.staging: Sad face, thinking over the sale.

storyboard.claim: Paul D does not know the market value of his brother.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Worried, thinking Paul D.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Gap in the math he cannot close.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the missing number as the gap.
storyboard.staging: Worried thinking face: the unknown price.

storyboard.claim: The schoolteacher is the ultimate accountant who knew every worth.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The schoolteacher holding the ledger notes with a smirk.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Introduces the accountant behind the ledger.
storyboard.addedInformation: The notes show the ledger; the smirk shows his cold confidence.
storyboard.staging: Smirk: the calm accountant of people, not a friendly face.

storyboard.claim: He sees commodities valued by age, teeth, and temperament, not souls.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Blank schoolteacher thinking, Paul D beside him.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Describes how the accountant values people.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the three traits as the valuation.
storyboard.staging: Blank face: apathy, no soul seen.

storyboard.claim: The tin box was a brilliant survival mechanism.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Worried, thinking Paul D with the survival callout.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The hosts debate the tin box.
storyboard.addedInformation: Quotes the praise as the debated view.
storyboard.staging: Thinking face: the debate, not a settled verdict.

storyboard.claim: The tin kept him moving through the chain gang and the escape.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Paul D walking on a road, one foot in front of the other.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains the survival argument.
storyboard.addedInformation: Road icon reads literally as the escape route.
storyboard.staging: Walk and road: persistence and escape.

storyboard.claim: He finally makes it to 124 Bluestone Road.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A home icon with Paul D walking on the road.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The escape ends at the house.
storyboard.addedInformation: Home icon names the house literally.
storyboard.staging: Walking toward the house; neutral, arriving.

storyboard.claim: The tin box saved his body, but the cost was profound.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Worried, thinking Paul D.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Turns from praise to cost.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the cost as the question.
storyboard.staging: Thinking face for the cost.

storyboard.claim: The tin made him emotionally bankrupt when freedom arrives.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Sad, slumped Paul D.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The tragedy of Paul D.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the emptiness the narration describes.
storyboard.staging: Slump and sadness for the tragedy.

storyboard.claim: Stamp Paid shows Paul D the newspaper clipping.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Stamp Paid holding the clipping, Paul D beside him.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The clipping that breaks Paul D.
storyboard.addedInformation: Notes show the printed clipping.
storyboard.staging: Stamp Paid leads, holding the clipping; worried.

storyboard.claim: The clipping details what Sethe did, and Paul D runs.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Afraid Paul D holding the notes of the clipping.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The clipping's content.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the event without staging it.
storyboard.staging: Afraid face holding the clipping; no harm drawn.

storyboard.claim: Paul D rejects Sethe's love and walks out the door.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Paul D walking toward a door, Sethe behind him.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The rupture after the clipping.
storyboard.addedInformation: Quotes his words as the narrator's rejection.
storyboard.staging: Walk toward the door: he leaves.

storyboard.claim: He has no emotional currency left to spend.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Blank Paul D, emptied.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains why he leaves.
storyboard.addedInformation: Currency is a metaphor, so no coin icon is used.
storyboard.staging: Blank face: the emptied account.

storyboard.claim: The ledger counts a beating heart as a rusted tin box.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Sad, slumped Paul D.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The consequence of the tin box.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the ledger's valuation of the heart.
storyboard.staging: Slump: isolation and the wandering shell.

storyboard.claim: Surviving bondage ruins the capacity for love.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Sad, thinking Paul D.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Closes the chapter's argument.
storyboard.addedInformation: Names the capacity lost as the price of survival.
storyboard.staging: Thinking, sad face; the callout carries the claim.
